en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a religious painting showing the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child seated in a richly patterned rose garden, surrounded by angels. There is a circular stamp‑like mark with the letters "M.C. T." in the upper right of the image. Below the picture is a printed caption identifying the artwork and its location, along with the publisher's details. A handwritten number appears in the bottom right margin.
